title: enhanced-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback-workflows
author: Ava Patel
description: Context: This PR extends the unified rollout controller to improve safety and observability for canary, A/B, and shadow deployments by adding proactive auto-rollback workflows, multi-metric hazard detection, staged probing for shadow traffic, and tighter stability guards. Motivation: customers running mixed latency-sensitive and throughput workloads under Dedicated and Private deployments reported rolling forward unstable model variants due to delayed metric correlation and insufficient shadow probing. This changeset provides: 1) a new stagedShadowProbe step that probes candidate models with low-percentage shadow traffic and escalates to canary if probes are healthy; 2) multi-metric autorollback policies (latency, error-rate, perplexity drift) with configurable thresholds and hysteresis windows; 3) a proactive rollback orchestrator that can preemptively revert a rollout if composite metrics indicate degradation even before SLA alerts fire; 4) observability hooks to export per-stage metrics and reasons for rollback to the Console and alerting pipelines; 5) e2e tests that simulate instability and verify safety guards. Checklist: - [x] implement staged shadow probing step - [x] implement composite-metric evaluator with hysteresis - [x] add pro-active rollback orchestration and policy API - [x] add Console telemetry for rollback reasoning - [x] add unit and e2e tests - [x] update docs and rollout examples Related: ENG-2345 (design), SUP-1021 (customer-reported incident), previous work on auto-rollback: pr-30211 and pr-34678. Rollout: feature gated behind rollout.autorollback.v2 and enabled for canary/weighted deployments only. Backwards compatibility: defaults preserve previous behavior; policies must be explicitly configured to opt into composite detection. Migration notes: simple config additions for existing rollout specs; docs updated in /docs/rollouts/autorollback.md.

release_notes: Enhanced rollout autorollback: staged shadow probing, composite multi-metric detection with hysteresis, and proactive rollback orchestration. Configurable policies and Console visibility for rollback reasons. Backwards compatible; opt-in via rollout.autorollback.v2. See docs/rollouts/autorollback.md for configuration examples.
notes_for_ops: Feature is feature-gated. Recommend enabling rollout.autorollback.v2 in a single staging namespace and validating dashboards before global enable. Watch the new telemetry metric rollouts.rollback_reason_count and the composite evaluator histogram to tune thresholds.
